### What was unresolved at `f5755e6`, and why this import fixes it
`user_work_slice_admit_against` calls `measure_fits(...)` (line 401). The `std.measure` import list (line 8) at `f5755e6` brought in the **type** `MeasureFit`, its arms `Fits`/`Below`, and the **function** `measure_sub` — but **not the function `measure_fits`** itself. So `measure_sub` resolved (imported) while `measure_fits` did not, and the effect resolver reported *"call to 'measure_fits' has no established callee identity"* at `slice_bounds.dag:401:47` — the failure in heal run **42328355922** (judged checkout `f5755e6`, == head metadata). The fix adds `measure_fits` to that import. It is one line, **no behaviour change beyond the import**, and it aligns `slice_bounds` with `gunbc.compute.host_capacity` `compute_reserve_against`, which already imports `measure_fits` — so both consumers share the one fit rule (`std/measure.dag` `fn measure_fits`). Note: heal fails fast and had not yet reached the belt, so a full-diff import-resolution audit (separate PR comment) confirmed this was the **only** resolution defect in the diff.
